category.reason: The target requires filtering applications by total downloads, rating and package size, comparing their download counts over the last seven days, and locating the SHA-256 in the selected row.

instruction.en: Among the apps with more than 10 million total downloads, a rating of at least 4.7, and a package size between 100 and 350 MB inclusive, find the package SHA-256 of the app with the fewest downloads in the last 7 days.
instruction.zh: 在总下载量超过 1,000 万、评分不低于 4.7 且安装包体积为 100 至 350 MB（含边界）的应用中，找到近 7 天下载量最少的应用的安装包 SHA-256。

reference.patch: Added instruction.en by translating the original Chinese instruction.
